WITH race_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    r.name,
    AVG(ds.points) as avg_points,
    COUNT(*) as field_size
  FROM races r
  INNER JOIN driverStandings ds ON r.raceId = ds.raceId
  GROUP BY r.name
),
overall_stats AS (
  SELECT AVG(field_size) as overall_avg_field_size
  FROM race_stats
),
above_average AS (
  SELECT rs.avg_points, rs.field_size
  FROM race_stats rs
  CROSS JOIN overall_stats os
  WHERE rs.field_size > os.overall_avg_field_size
)
SELECT
  AVG(aa.avg_points) as avg_of_avg_points,
  AVG(aa.field_size) as avg_of_field_sizes,
  AVG(aa.field_size) - (SELECT overall_avg_field_size FROM overall_stats) as field_size_above_avg
FROM above_average aa

assumptions.assumption: 'how big its standings field is' means COUNT(*) of driverStandings records grouped by race name—the number of drivers with standings data for that race.
